package.description: With our free Vernier Instrumental Analysis® app, students can collect and analyze data from our Go Direct Mini GC™, Go Direct Polarimeter, and Go Direct Cyclic Voltammetry System using computers, Chromebooks, or other mobile devices.

en-US.description: With our free Vernier Instrumental Analysis® app, students can collect and analyze data from our Go Direct Mini GC™, Go Direct Polarimeter, and Go Direct Cyclic Voltammetry System using computers, Chromebooks, or other mobile devices.
en-US.longDescription: Incorporate advanced instrumentation seamlessly into your chemistry curriculum with our free Vernier Instrumental Analysis® app. This user‑friendly tool simplifies data collection and analysis, enabling students to effortlessly gather and share professional‑grade data. Compatible with the Go Direct® Mini GC™, Go Direct Polarimeter, and Go Direct Cyclic Voltammetry System, this app offers features like peak integration and voltammogram analysis.
en-US.name: Vernier Instrumental Analysis

zh-CN.description: 通过我们免费的 Vernier Instrumental Analysis® 应用，学生可以使用电脑、Chromebook 或其他移动设备，从 Go Direct Mini GC™、Go Direct Polarimeter 和 Go Direct Cyclic Voltammetry System 中采集并分析数据。
zh-CN.longDescription: 通过我们免费的 Vernier Instrumental Analysis® 应用程序，将先进仪器无缝融入您的化学课程。这款用户友好型工具简化了数据收集与分析流程，让学生能够轻松获取并共享专业级数据。该应用兼容 Go Direct® Mini GC™、Go Direct Polarimeter 和 Go Direct Cyclic Voltammetry System，提供峰面积积分和伏安图分析等专业功能。
